source_text.ISS-0937:
id: ISS-0937
title: "Backend CI red at UTC month boundary: TenantTemplateTest parity (extra events_y2026m09) and PartitionMaintenance/RetentionOperations/EventRetention tests ({:error,:partition_not_eligible}) fail on 2026-10-01"
discovered_by: ELIXIR-DEV
discovered_in_run: WF03-ISS0930-20261001 (Step Final, PR #2076; filed by ORCH)
discovered_at: "2026-10-01T00:21:56Z"
severity: MAJOR
description: >
  PR #2076 (scripts/fixtures-only, no lib/ or migration change) had its backend job fail twice. Run 1: one TenantTemplateTest
  parity failure extra=["events_y2026m09"]. Re-run after the 2026-09-30 to 2026-10-01 UTC rollover: 12 failures in
  PartitionMaintenanceTest, RetentionOperationsTest, EventRetentionTest ({:error, :partition_not_eligible}). Hypothesis, not
  reproduced on main: the tests depend on the real current UTC month / partition eligibility and break at the month boundary.
  PR #2076 was merged with --admin per decision 0018. Confirm via main's CI on ed40c2fa, then make the tests clock-independent.
affected_files:
  - test/letflow/events/ (partition maintenance / retention tests)
  - test/letflow/tenants/ (tenant template parity test)
queue_ref: Q-920  # queue issue_ref ISS-0920 collides with an existing local file; local filename ISS-0937
github_ref: GH-2077
status: open

task.description: WF-03 Step 5 CLOSE ISSUE for ISS-0937. Edit docs/issues/ISS-0937.yaml: status: resolved, resolved_in_run: WF03-ISS0937-20261001, resolved_at: <real UTC from `date -u +%FT%TZ`>; add a short `resolution:` note (root cause: two test-side month-boundary dependencies - eligible_past_month used last month as always-eligible, which fails on the 1st with min_partition_age_days=1 because eligibility requires today >= 1st of next month + N days; and check_table_set/2 flagged a stale dynamic events_yYYYYmMM partition as extra when the template was built in a different UTC month; production lib/ was correct and unchanged), `regression_tests:` [test/support/partition_clock_test.exs, test/support/tenant_template_test.exs (ISS-0937 describe)], and `main_ci_evidence:` main CI runs 36795709173 (ed40c2fa) and 36795979277 (590c923f) both completed FAILURE on the same 12 tests (8 PartitionMaintenanceTest, 3 RetentionOperationsTest, 1 EventRetentionTest) on 2026-10-01 (green before: 36785684070). Keep existing keys (queue_ref Q-920, github_ref GH-2077); check the Issue status vocabulary in docs/agents/protocols/ISSUE_QUEUE.md so `resolved` uses exactly the right key pair, and verify with `mix letflow.lint_issues` or the repo's issue lint task if one exists (run it, quote result). IMPORTANT: do NOT run `gh issue close` in this step and do NOT call the queue - the PR is not merged yet; ORCH will close GH#2077 with the evidence comment after the merge lands and release the queue lock. Also propose, inside your handoff result.summary only (do not edit docs/anti-patterns.md), nothing else. Modify nothing but docs/issues/ISS-0937.yaml and this handoff. Set IN_PROGRESS at claim then COMPLETED/FAILED, result.status PASS/FAIL; next_action 'Route to Step Final'.
acceptance_criteria: Local record resolved with correct key pair and real timestamp

result.summary: Closed docs/issues/ISS-0937.yaml: status: resolved, resolved_in_run: WF03-ISS0937-20261001, resolved_at 2026-10-01T01:42:37Z (resolved/resolved_in_run/resolved_at is the correct pair per ISSUE_QUEUE.md; verdict_* is for no_defect only). Added resolution (two test-side month-boundary dependencies: eligible_past_month fails on the 1st with min_partition_age_days=1; check_table_set/2 flagged stale events_yYYYYmMM as extra across UTC months; lib/ unchanged), regression_tests (partition_clock_test.exs, tenant_template_test.exs ISS-0937 describe), main_ci_evidence (runs 36795709173, 36795979277 FAILURE on same 12 tests; green before 36785684070). queue_ref Q-920 and github_ref GH-2077 kept. Lint: `mix letflow.check_issue_refs` -> 'letflow.check_issue_refs -- 535 file(s) under docs/issues/ OK -- every cross-reference is prefixed and well-formed.' (no letflow.lint_issues task exists). YAML parses; status=resolved. No gh close, no queue call. Anti-pattern proposal (for ORCH/DOC-UPDATER, not applied): tests must not derive fixtures from the real wall-clock UTC month/day (e.g. 'last month is always eligible', or asserting a dynamic partition set built at a different time); inject a clock via test/support/partition_clock.ex and run suites near month boundaries.
